english.title: Drive a vehicle take less than 9 consecutive hours daily reduced rest interval - EC
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the driver of a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), failed to take a reduced daily rest period of at least nine consecutive hours, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERIOD OF REST TAKEN..), in contravention of Article 8(2) of the Community Drivers' Hours Regulations
english.legislation: Contrary to section 96(11A) of the Transport Act 1968.

english.notes:
(i) See Article 8(1) for circumstances in which the rest period may be reduced.
(ii) Where the place of the offence is uncertain, section 103(7) provides that the offence may be treated as having been committed at the place of driving, the person's place of residence or the principal place of business.
(iii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
